intent: Build a classroom attendance app with QR check-in, teacher dashboard, CSV export, and parent notification templates in English and Filipino.

spec.goal: Get a classroom attendance app that lets students check in by QR code and gives teachers a dashboard, CSV export, and parent notification templates in English and Filipino.
spec.deliverable: A working classroom attendance app with QR check-in, a teacher dashboard, CSV export of attendance records, and parent notification templates in English and Filipino.
constraints: Attendance must be recorded through QR code check-in.
The app must include a teacher dashboard for viewing attendance.
Attendance data must be exportable as a CSV file.
Parent notification templates must be provided in both English and Filipino.
Only the features named in the request are included; no extra integrations or capabilities are added.
done_criteria: A student can check in by scanning a QR code and the attendance is recorded.
The teacher dashboard shows attendance records.
Attendance records can be exported as a CSV file.
Parent notification templates exist in both English and Filipino.
spec.summary: You want a classroom attendance app where students check in with a QR code, teachers see a dashboard and export CSV, and parents get notification templates in English and Filipino.
